question: Of 10,000 athletes, 100 dope. A test flags 90% of dopers and 1% of clean athletes. How many flagged athletes are clean?
answer: 99 clean athletes, more than the 90 cheats caught
move: A rare cheat and a decent test still give many false accusations.
ask: When a check flags someone I know, how many innocent people would that same check also have flagged?
trap: Expecting almost every flagged athlete to be a cheat.
hint: Count the clean athletes first, then take 1% of them.
steps: 99 clean athletes, more than the 90 cheats caught
reference: Donald A. Berry, The science of doping, Nature, 2008
